name: android_pinch_gesture
description: Two-finger pinch around a center point: scale > 1 zooms in, < 1 zooms out. centerX/centerY are screen fractions when within 0.0-1.0, otherwise pixels.

scale.description: Scale factor (> 1.0 zooms in, e.g. 1.5; < 1.0 zooms out, e.g. 0.5).

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
